card.name: Capital letters inside all-caps phrases
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a word that begins in an all-caps heading or warning, such as a drug name after OF, TO or NOT BE USED. It marks that the text is continuing in capitals.

modes.label: Drug name starting in caps
modes.description: A single capital letter that starts a drug name in an all-caps warning or table heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF<< F>>ENTANYL CITRATE INJECTION See

modes.label: Other all-caps headings
modes.description: The start of a capitalized name or phrase in a non-drug all-caps title or sentence.
modes.example: DO NOT FEED<< C>>ROCODILES: Feeding crocod

card.writes: It favors upper-case endings and joiners like AND, OF, IZED and ATION, which keeps the text in all capitals.
card.plain: It notices when a passage is written in all capitals and helps keep the next word in capitals.
